name: Accounting
description: Owns financial recognition, books, journals, receivables and payables, reconciliation, period close, approved budgets, allocations and qualified valuation under native or explicitly selected external authority.

provides.description: Administer entity-scoped books, accounts and controlled accounting periods.
Validate and recognise financial facts through balanced journals and attributable corrections.
Supply authorised outstanding balances, ageing and settlement status.
Match qualified statement evidence and resolve exceptions.
Maintain approved financial budgets, allocations and reporting-basis provenance.
Supply carrying values, depreciation, impairment and recognised cost.
Supply qualified financial statements, tax-control figures and scoped exports.
Govern native/external authority selection, cutover and uncertain outcomes.
Distinguish requested, confirmed and uncertain accounting outcomes.
